szenen.text: Bitcoin is at {bis}, {vom_hoch} from its 120 day high. Daily RSI: {rsi}.
szenen.text_ohne: Bitcoin just had a brutal week.

szenen.text: This week: Nvidia's CEO resigned, the dollar hit its strongest level since April 2025, and the odds of a bigger Fed hike went up.

The line to watch now: the 200 week average at {wma}. Bitcoin trades {wma_lage} it. The 200 day EMA at {ema} is already lost, and the daily RSI is {rsi}. A daily close below the 200 week line would be a bearish signal. Holding it leaves room for a bounce.
